patterns.hint: Fill any row, column or diagonal.

patterns.label: Four corners
patterns.hint: Spot the four plants in the corners.

patterns.label: Blackout
patterns.hint: Spot all 25 plants on the card.
patterns.win: Full card. Every plant on the board.

hunt.comment: Hunt: every plant, one checklist across cards
